question: Simplify: 25 - (18 - 4 × 9 ÷ 3)
solution:
**Given:**

Simplify: 25 - (18 - 4 × 9 ÷ 3)

**Formula Used:**

Order of Operations (BODMAS/BIDMAS): Brackets, Orders (i.e. powers and square roots, etc.), Division and Multiplication, Addition and Subtraction.

**Calculation:**

⇒ 25 - (18 - 4 × 9 ÷ 3)

⇒ 25 - (18 - 36 ÷ 3)

⇒ 25 - (18 - 12)

⇒ 25 - 6

⇒ 19

**The correct answer is option 4.**
